svg.title: SegmentLab joint posterior draw audit
svg.desc: First three complete sampled latent paths versus exact pointwise mean; exact and10000-draw count and boundary probabilities and latent variances. Zero K4 visits do not imply zero posterior mass. All points shown, no credible bands.
svg.text: SegmentLab | a sampled partition is not a marginal average
Seed19; all10,000 draws; four observed values[-.7,-.4,.6,.9]; all8 admissible partitions.
sigma.5, prior mean0 / std3, gap-cut p.08, min_length1, cap4. Offline model-conditional development audit.
A. First three complete latent-mean draws
Observation index; path steps occur at segment boundaries.
Teal: exact mean. Black dots: observations.
Gray paths: draws1 solid,2 dashed,3 dotted. Not bands.
First3 in generation order, not selected for fit.
K (segments). Teal: exact mass; black: draw frequency.
K4: positive exact mass, zero visits. Not a zero posterior.
C. Cut probability, all interior gaps
Cut before zero-based index; exact / frequency below.
Shared probability scale[0,1] with count panel.
Exact teal / sampled black (divisor10,000). No sigma².
All indices, counts and gaps shown. Numerical sums/RNG have finite precision; rare mass may not be sampled.
Joint paths exclude future observation noise. No credible bands, event labels, online forecast or real-data calibration.
